name: infrared
description: Claude Code plugins for Infrared, Darkshift's software factory for people who work with agents.

plugins.name: infrared-change
plugins.description: Infrared's change conventions as skills and hooks: a branch of its own for each Change, conventional commits, the pull request's body, evidence, the verdict, the progress entry, the hand-off and the rollout-flag lifecycle; a hook that refuses a commit whose subject is not conventional, and one that asks for the pull request's body before a builder session in ir local work ends.

plugins.name: infrared-telemetry
plugins.description: Records your Claude Code sessions in clones of your org's Product repositories as Sessions in Infrared, through ir, signed in to your install: the Product, the branch, tool calls by name, files edited, commits, pushes, the pull request, tokens and a cost estimate; never a prompt, a word of the conversation, a path or a file's content. Without ir signed in, it does nothing.

plugins.name: infrared-support
plugins.description: Infrared's support agent in your own Claude Code: it answers how to do something in Infrared, why a Change, run, build or deployment stopped or failed, and where something stands, from Infrared's public docs and your org's own records read through ir, and changes nothing. A hook holds it to ir's read commands and the docs; what needs a person, it writes up for them.
